🎬 Revenge of the Bridesmaids (2010)

Revenge of the Bridesmaids follows Abigail and Parker, two childhood best friends who return to their hometown and discover that their former friend Caitlyn is planning to marry Tony, the longtime boyfriend of their close friend Rachel. Convinced that Caitlyn is marrying him for the wrong reasons, the two women decide to become bridesmaids and secretly sabotage the wedding. What begins as a plan to protect their friend quickly turns into a series of hilarious schemes, unexpected complications, and outrageous wedding disasters. As their mission becomes increasingly chaotic, Abigail and Parker must navigate friendship, romance, and loyalty while trying to expose the truth before the big day. Filled with comedy, clever tricks, and heartfelt moments, the film explores friendship, love, and standing up for the people who matter most.

🎭 Genre: Romantic Comedy • Comedy • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 5.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 35m • TV-PG

🎥 Director: James Hayman

✍️ Writers: David Kendall & Bob Young

source_details.synopsis: Revenge of the Bridesmaids is a 2010 ABC Family Original Movie that premiered on July 18, 2010. It stars Raven-Symoné as Abigail and JoAnna García as Parker, undercover bridesmaids with a mission to break up a wedding. In addition, the film's cast also features Virginia Williams, Beth Broderick, Chryssie Whitehead, David Clayton Rogers, Lyle Brocato and Brittany Ishibashi.
